title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der zweiten ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ 2026 – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police report results of the ROADPOL Speedweek speed-check campaign from 3 to 9 August 2026, with 12,413 speeding violations found at 247 checkpoints. Speed checks will continue year-round and a focus on school routes starts with the new school year.
